Wet Bandits Return – v4 Snow Edition

How to use:
1. Open index.html in a browser to play the game locally.
2. To deploy on GitHub Pages, upload all files in this folder to your repo
   (for example, /wet-bandits-return/) and enable GitHub Pages.

Upgrading later:
- To replace the "scene moment" text with images or MP4 clips, edit script.js.
- You can use the clipText field per scene as a caption and add your own
  <img> or <video> elements in index.html wired to the currentSceneIndex.
